lineas.texto: One implant case can pay for your whole website.
Responsive prosthodontic websites: what patients check on their phone before calling.
Every missed dental appointment is money that never comes back. Unless your system recovers it.
Responsive prosthodontic websites have to work on a phone first, because that's where patients compare specialists.
A page for each high-value treatment: implants, dentures, crowns. What it is, how long, financing, and a booking button.
Behind it, a dental CRM: automatic reminders that cut no-shows, six-month recall messages, and a simple patient portal.
Want to see your practice on this? Comment DEMO.
